title: WorkspaceBoundaryPolicy
description: Serialized workspace boundary policy handed to a data plane that enforces it out of process. Produced by dataagent-backend core/boundary_policy.build_boundary_policy and consumed by the Pi Cell's workspace-boundary-enforcer. The Python side stays the single source of truth for the rules; the two enforcement implementations are kept in agreement by the shared case table in conformance-cases.json.

profile.description: claude_code carries the CLI's offloaded tool-result exception. pi_agent_core is a strict subset: that Cell truncates tool output in process and never offloads it to disk, so tool_result_root is null and readonly_commands is empty.

workspace_root.description: Absolute path a relative tool argument resolves against.

allowed_roots.description: Absolute roots a resolved path may sit under. Output of _build_workspace_allowed_roots: the topic workspace, enabled skill roots, and configured scratch dirs.

allowed_executables.description: Absolute paths a Bash command may invoke from outside the allowed roots, currently just DATAAGENT_PYTHON_BIN.

discard_sinks.description: Paths matched exactly and always permitted. /dev/null is a fixed POSIX property, not a deployment choice; anything under it stays denied.

tool_path_keys.description: Per-tool argument names that carry a filesystem path.

operator_chars.description: Characters the shell tokenizer treats as standalone operator runs, so a redirect target is checked instead of hidden inside a glued token.

tool_result_root.description: Root of the CLI's per-project offloaded tool-result files, or null when the profile has no offloading.

readonly_commands.description: Command words that behave as read filters, used only to keep the offloaded tool-result exception read-only. Empty when tool_result_root is null. Pagers are deliberately excluded: LESSOPEN can execute arbitrary preprocessors.
